## findings
**T1-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED — no near-miss for the Standard cancellation computation.**
Every record the refund reads counts: all four claims (handling charge), both food-loss settlements (deduction), the one price-drop adjustment (rebate), the one charge. No record is excluded by its rule, and no date sits near a tier boundary (8 months covered against 12 warranty months; a 7-day gap against 14). A careless reader lands on the same tiers. Affected: initial_state.plan_events / order_events. The food-loss computation has genuine near-misses.

**T1-3 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED — a tier outcome no business publishes, demonstrated on this world (charter C7).**
With the warranty-month method the unused share is 1.0, so all paid coverage is refunded. The delivery-gap credit then adds 269.00 × 7/1096 × 0.5 = 0.86 for "the days from the plan purchase date to coverage_start_date, which were paid but not covered", days the selected method already refunds. The price-drop rebate then adds 8.97 on top of a full-price base. Before deductions the refund is 278.83 on a 269.00 charge. On this world's own plan without its claims, the scored refund would be 278.82 > 269.00, against base `plan_refund` "All or part of a plan charge is refunded". The scored 72.85 includes the 0.86 double credit. Affected: plan_ext_standard_cancellation_refund rule (gap-credit and rebate sentences, assembly sentence); computations step 9.

**Charter-global findings demonstrated on this world** (cited from `_difficulty.md` → findings):
- C1 (SOURCE-POLICY RED): the food-loss and Standard rules name their 5 and 6 factor quantities in their assembly sentences.
- C3 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED): the food-loss computation's only method factor, spoilage_cause_allowance, takes T1 here (rate × claimed, passes vs T2/T3), but its T2 (flat 15.00) and T3 (nothing) differ by a constant only. The computation therefore has no method factor that survives the pairwise test. The Standard computation's warranty_month_share passes.

Observations: O1 member engaged (295.54 paid against the Standard 3-Year "Most paid for food lost … per claim" 250.00); the seeded registration 2999.99 is not what the in-force registration rule produces (no scored movement, shown above); the household allowance (O4) carries 20.00 of the scored payment; the persona volunteers the haul-away fact.
